vasco_m_who: [bitter, scared] And someone has to go down. Into the water, at the door, and set them while it rises. [pause] [voice cracking] You said it on the rock. I hated it then. I hate it now.
vasco_m_wrong_2: [shouting, panicked] Alan! It's at your chest! [desperate] Please. [pause] Listen to me.
vasco_m_light: [shouting, frantic] I've lost the light! I can't read it without the light!
vasco_m_seventh_3: [urgent, fast, steadying himself] Tip it towards you, and its light comes down off the shaft and across the wall. I'll tell you where it lands. [firm] Dead centre.
vasco_m_dead_centre: [tense, firm, almost shouting] Dead centre, Alan! Not close.
vasco_m_true: [urgent, breathless] There. There. Stop! Alan. Stop. Don't move. [pause] [shaky relief] That's it. That's the one.
vasco_m_hold: [through gritted teeth, straining, fierce] No. [pause] [shouting] No, you don't!
vasco_m_stopped: [gasping, shaking, angry and frightened] You stopped. I saw your face. [voice breaking] You were letting it take you.
vasco_m_twice: [out of breath, raw, close to tears] I've let go of people before. I got on a train once, in the middle of the night, and let go of the best man I ever knew.
vasco_m_twice_2: [quiet, fierce, tearful] I wasn't going to do it twice.
